def solve(case):
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be a dict")
    threshold = case.get('threshold')
    if threshold is None or not isinstance(threshold, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("threshold must be a number")
    calls = case.get('calls')
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls must be a list")
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        if not isinstance(call, dict):
            raise ValueError("each call must be a dict")
        call_id = call.get('call_id')
        loss_without = call.get('loss_without_call')
        loss_with = call.get('loss_with_call')
        pred_tokens = call.get('prediction_tokens')
        parseable = call.get('parseable')
        # validate presence and types
        if any(v is None for v in [call_id, loss_without, loss_with, pred_tokens, parseable]):
            raise ValueError("missing required fields in call")
        if not isinstance(call_id, str):
            raise ValueError("call_id must be string")
        if not isinstance(loss_without, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("loss_without_call must be number")
        if not isinstance(loss_with, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("loss_with_call must be number")
        if not isinstance(pred_tokens, int) or pred_tokens <= 0:
            raise ValueError("prediction_tokens must be positive int")
        if not isinstance(parseable, bool):
            raise ValueError("parseable must be boolean")
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / pred_tokens
        # round to 8 decimal places
        normalized_gain_rounded = round(normalized_gain, 8)
        gain_rounded = round(gain, 8)
        diag = {
            "call_id": call_id,
            "gain": gain_rounded,
            "normalized_gain": normalized_gain_rounded
        }
        diagnostics.append(diag)
        if parseable and normalized_gain >= threshold:
            accepted.append(call_id)
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
